newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 6.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The People's Bank of China, the central bank, has issued an urgent directive banning state banks from trading on the stock markes and the state debt repurchase and spot secondary markets.
- A commentary says the ban on state banks trading on the stock markets will effectively prevent banks from collaborating with other financial institutions to speculate on the markets.
- China has issued new domestic A shares with a face value of 6.1 billion yuan from 116 companies so far this year.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's per capita gross domestic product is expected to exceed $3,000 for the first time this year.
